'''Ryan Bartley''' is a voice actress for the English dub of {{aniseries|JN}} and [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. She is currently affiliated with AVO Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Bartley was born on February 3, 1998, in Forth Worth, Texas, USA, and became a voice actress as a child. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', where she voiced several characters and Pokémon, her most notable being that of [[Allister]] and [[Goh]]'s {{p|Alcremie}}.
